description: A long cream linen tunic with narrow gold woven edging beneath a deep plum patterned outer coat and heavy draped shoulder mantle with broad ornamental gold borders. Small round metal clasps linked by a chain fasten the mantle across the upper chest. A decorated leather belt with a round metal buckle secures the waist. Long sleeves cover the wrists, and tall brown leather boots are visible below the garments. No headgear, armor or weapons are present.
